page: Microsoft Azure EC64eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. Powered by an Intel x86_64 processor, this instance provides 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The underlying virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

For local storage needs, the EC64eds_v6 includes a bundled 3780 GB NVMe SSD. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there are no integrated GPUs on this server configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the EC64eds_v6 offers a dense allocation of memory and fast local NVMe storage relative to its 64-core compute footprint. This resource balance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require rapid local scratch space. Suitable workloads include large-scale relational databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and data warehousing applications.
